purpose: Development-stage recovery of deliberately hidden PHerc0139 w035 material by selecting one CT-supported component of the independently published surface-m7 prediction from visible four-sided boundary anchors, then snapping a truth-blind coarse material-grid continuation to that selected component.
claim_boundary: A development PASS means this fixed multi-sided connected-component recovery rule reconstructs the six already-development-exposed 21x21 hidden w035 patches with the frozen geometric accuracy and wrong-wrap rejection gates. It does not prove arbitrary whole-scroll recovery, complete recto coverage, Grand Prize eligibility, ink, readability, or transfer to an eligible 2027 volume. Promotion requires a separately frozen untouched holdout and then exact-prize-volume transfer.

failed_identity_families: discrete-harmonic material-grid continuation as physical reconstruction
provenance.new_information_source: No new model is introduced. The already-frozen independent surface-m7 prediction is now used as candidate geometry. Visible submitted-surface boundary points select its local 3-D connected component; hidden reference XYZ is scoring-only.

search_padding_basis.development_dataset: Stage-B 21x21 deletion results on the same six development-exposed centers
search_padding_basis.note: 64 exceeds the already-observed development error ceiling before any connected-component response is read. This is a search envelope, not an acceptance tolerance.

development_regions.reuse_disclosure: These six centers were already used by Stage A/B development and are deliberately reused to develop a new recovery mechanism. They are not a holdout.

candidate_generation_firewall.hidden_reference_use: Scoring only, after the complete candidate recovered XYZ grid, selected component identity, and all abstentions have been frozen in memory.
visible_inputs_allowed: frozen deletion rectangle and center ID
candidate_generation_firewall.metamorphic_test: Perturbing or replacing hidden reference XYZ/validity after hiding must not change candidate generation bytes.

coarse_material_prior.role: search/correspondence prior only; never accepted as recovered geometry
coarse_material_prior.input: TIFXYZ with the complete 21x21 rectangle hidden as NaN/invalid before solving

visible_boundary_anchors.corner_policy: Corners belong to top/bottom only; left/right omit their endpoints so each material anchor has one side label.
visible_boundary_anchors.normal_method: centered TIFXYZ tangent cross-product computed only from visible cells after the deletion
visible_boundary_anchors.association_rule: At each visible boundary anchor, sample surface-m7 and masked CT along the frozen visible normal. A seed exists where prediction >127 and CT >0. Choose smallest absolute offset; negative wins an exact tie.
visible_boundary_anchors.invalid_seed_policy: Missing/out-of-bounds/unsupported anchors remain absent; no replacement ring or offset is allowed.

local_prediction_component.box_rule: Take the axis-aligned level-0 voxel bounding box over all harmonic hidden coordinates and all valid visible seed coordinates, then pad each side by exactly 64 voxels and crop to CT bounds.
local_prediction_component.raw_candidate_mask: surface-m7 stored value >127 AND masked CT stored value >0
local_prediction_component.connectivity_mask: One Chebyshev-radius-1 binary dilation of raw_candidate_mask, used only to establish component labels.
local_prediction_component.raw_geometry_rule: Recovered coordinates must come from raw_candidate_mask voxels, never dilation-only voxels.
local_prediction_component.seed_label_rule: A visible seed votes for the connectivity label at its associated raw candidate voxel.
local_prediction_component.eligible_component_rule: A component is eligible only if it receives at least one valid seed from all four sides, at least 50% of all valid seeds, and at least 3 seeds from each side.
local_prediction_component.selection_rule: Exactly one eligible component is required. Zero or multiple eligible components cause center-level abstention; no nearest/tie-break fallback is permitted.

recovered_geometry.material_cells: Generate one candidate coordinate for every material-grid cell in the hidden 21x21 rectangle without consulting hidden reference validity.
recovered_geometry.snap_source: Raw surface-prediction+CT-supported voxels belonging to the selected connectivity component.
recovered_geometry.snap_rule: For each harmonic coarse coordinate, choose its nearest raw selected-component voxel by Euclidean distance; scipy cKDTree k=1 ordering is deterministic for unique voxel coordinates.
recovered_geometry.abstention_rule: If nearest selected-component raw geometry is farther than 64 voxels, that material cell is unrecovered.
recovered_geometry.duplicate_reporting: Report unique recovered voxel fraction separately; duplicates do not disappear from the accuracy denominator.

scoring.scoring_truth: Original hidden TIFXYZ bytes, read only after candidate generation is complete.
scoring.valid_hidden_vertex_denominator: Every originally valid TIFXYZ material vertex inside the frozen 21x21 rectangle.
metrics_per_center: fraction of valid hidden vertices recovered within each tolerance
median/p95/max Euclidean recovered-XYZ error on candidate-available valid hidden vertices
boundary seed counts and shares by side
minimum Euclidean distance from recovered coordinates to frozen adjacent-winding control
scoring.wrong_wrap_rejection_rule: No recovered coordinate may lie within 8 voxels of the frozen adjacent-winding control coordinate.

development_gate.denominator_rule: Unselected/abstained centers contribute zero to fraction-within-8 when computing the all-six median; selected-center-only gates cannot hide abstention.
development_gate.decision_rule: PASS only if every numeric and wrong-wrap gate passes simultaneously. Otherwise FAIL. No manual override or threshold tuning.
development_gate.pass_action: Freeze the identical algorithm and thresholds in a separate preregistration on an untouched holdout before reading holdout component structure or recovery error.
development_gate.fail_action: Preserve the negative result and change the information/recovery mechanism; do not tune these thresholds on the six observed centers.
